protocol.status: Retrospective diagnostic on previously inspected seasons; no production promotion
protocol.rosterSource: Last eligible team box-score roster; not a verified pregame roster or transaction history
protocol.monteCarloSelection: Lowest deterministic game-ID hash per season, chosen without outcomes
protocol.candidate: Joint resampling of complete earlier team rotations; 20-game template window and six-game half-life; fixed 5% independent support mixture
protocol.gate: Research only: missing point-in-time roster, injury and transaction evidence prevents promotion regardless of retrospective improvements
protocol.calibration: Separate regularized logistic family fits on earlier seasons only; five fixed diagnostic thresholds per family, not bookmaker lines

uncertainty.method: Paired UTC-day cluster bootstrap; candidate minus baseline point absolute error

promotion.reason: Proxy rosters, reused seasons and diagnostic thresholds cannot establish production injury/transaction or bookmaker calibration validity.

limitations: Player pools remain previous-box-score proxies with omissions documented in allocation-research-artifact.json. No target-game roster or injury status enters prediction.

A zero-support issue in the initial research replay prompted a fixed 5% independent support component before this run. These reused seasons are not an untouched test. Joint templates preserve observed past participation/minute dependence but cannot anticipate an unobserved current injury or transaction.
Family calibration uses model-independent fixed diagnostic thresholds and earlier seasons; historical Sportsbet quote coverage is unavailable. These fits are never marked eligible for live use.
Calibration uncertainty is limited by the 72-game sample and within-game/alternate-line dependence. Actual matched-time forward comparisons remain the acceptance evidence.
